# Heavy / campaign tools — peptides are small (T4 often enough); a macrocycle campaign prefers Pro.
# Install on Colab in the sessions that actually run the models. Pin what you used.
# These PRODUCE the metrics the shared filter scores; the filter itself needs none of them.
#   BoltzGen      (peptide-anything / macrocycle-anything)  # VERIFY the current public release + URL — it is moving. Pin it.
#   EvoBind2      https://github.com/patrickbryant1/EvoBind  # MSA-free cyclic/linear peptide binder design (VERIFY). Pin a commit.
#   boltz         https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz         # Boltz-2 structure + AFFINITY (relative ranking only — never a K_D). Pin the version.
#   ColabFold     https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabFold     # AF2 / AF2-Multimer pAE on the peptide–MDM2 complex. Pin a commit.
# Optional (peptide-vs-protein MODALITY FOIL — the Project-06 mini-binder arm, A100):
#   BindCraft     https://github.com/martinpacesa/BindCraft  # one-shot mini-binder foil (A100). Pin a commit.
#   RFdiffusion   https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion  # binder-mode foil (A100). Pin a commit.
# Conceptual reference (no pip): RFpeptides — cyclic-peptide design concepts (read the paper; verify availability).
